description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink project and handles the export of platform data for a test project. It defines functions to initialize parameters, prepare the export GUI, execute data export to XML, and check user permissions.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP object used for parameter and GUI configuration storage.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and validates arguments for the platform export process, retrieving the test project name and filename.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares and returns a GUI configuration object for the export page.

methods.name: doExport
methods.description: Performs the export of platform data for a specified test project into an XML file.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has permission to view platform data for the project.
